title: Fiserv — moves more than money
tagline: From a content-grid corporate home to a brand-faithful redesign with three multi-variant theses (proof-at-the-top, JTBD doorways, product-forward).

direction.phrase: redesign this home page to make it better

antiToolbox.note: No anti-toolbox moves invoked — the resolved direction is brand-faithful (palette + type pinned), so divergence-toolkit § 1 has nothing to flag.

variants.name: Proof at the top
variants.thesis: Hero leads with high-contrast headline + designed surface; the editorial-news register (decade-dominant) reads first. Audience-grid + about/life follow. Content sourced from captured pages/home.json; the proof-tiles, customer-logos, and named-products sections from the original render were trimmed before publish to keep claims to verified scope (10K+ FIs, 6M+ merchants from fiserv.com/about).

variants.name: Doorways (job-to-be-done first)
variants.thesis: Hero question + 5-doorway JTBD chooser as the primary IA — Accept payments / Issue a card / Run a bank / Embed finance / Modernise a core. The brand register (verb-led routing) reads first; audience-grid recedes to a secondary nav. proof-strip and customer-logos sections trimmed before publish.

variants.name: Product-forward
variants.thesis: Hero leads with the product list (Clover, Carat, Finxact). The editorial-news craft (named platforms first) reads first. The original render included 5 cards (with Forum and AppMarket); both were trimmed since Forum is the conference and AppMarket is a Clover sub-product, not peer platforms. proof-strip and customer-logos sections also trimmed.

_provenance.trimNote: All three variants had data-placeholder elements (proof-tiles, customer-logos, products) flagged in their _provenance.unsourcedContent[]. The publish flow refuses on non-empty unsourcedContent[]; rather than fabricate content, the unsourced sections were removed before publish. Each variant's primary thesis is preserved (A: editorial-led hero; B: JTBD chooser; C: product list trimmed to Clover/Carat/Finxact).
